audience: small business owners and bookkeepers in Germany who do invoicing with Lexware Office

useCases.title: Find open and unpaid invoices
useCases.text: The AI searches the voucher list by type and status and reads the open amount of each. It opens an invoice and its payments to see what was paid.

useCases.title: Look up customers and vendors
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name or email part and opens one for numbers, addresses, emails, phones and notes.

useCases.title: Read quotations, credit notes, delivery notes and reminders
useCases.text: The AI opens a quotation, credit note, delivery note or dunning (payment reminder) with status and line items, and totals where the document has them.

useCases.title: List articles with prices and posting categories
useCases.text: The AI lists your products and services with price, tax rate and unit, and the bookkeeping posting categories for income or outgo.

useCases.title: Add a customer or vendor, draft an invoice or quotation
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer or vendor contact, then a draft invoice or quotation. Drafts are not finalized or sent, so you check them in Lexware Office first.
